title: Flesh
description: Form Documentary Original Title Carne Country Spain, Brazil Year 2019 Running Time 12min Language Portuguese Director Camila Kater Screenwriter Camila Kater, Ana Julia Carvalheiro Producer Chelo Loureiro, Livia Perez Key Cast Rachel Patricio, Larissa Rahal, Raquel Virginia, Valquiria Rosa, Helena Ignez Director of Photography Samuel Mariani Editor Samuel Mariani Pedro has found a new job. A kind of strange one, but these days, he can’t afford to be fussy. It’s a real chance! Anyway, he’s never been the kind of getting cold feet ... Five women, each in a different stage of their life, share experiences about their relationships to their bodies and how others perceive them in this powerfully intimate mixed-media animated documentary from Camila Kater.
